# Prominent website header logo

Release requested by Justin Horton on October 18, 2026.

The shared header displays the approved V7 horizontal logo at 360px on wide
desktop and tablet layouts, and 300px between 1280px and 1439px. Phone layouts
give the logo more space while retaining Donate and the menu control with
44px touch targets. The artwork and its proportions are unchanged.

Validation: production static build, navigation artifact verification, brand
boundary validation, 22 existing browser navigation tests, visual review at
desktop/tablet/mobile sizes, and overlap/overflow checks at 15 widths from
320px through 1920px.

Publish with the existing Deploy web workflow, including the protected account
runtime build and live navigation/account verification.
